datasets.name: payers
queryLines:
WITH v AS (
    SELECT payer, MEASURE(visits) AS visits
    FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.operations
    GROUP BY ALL
),
final AS (
    SELECT 'All' AS payer
    UNION ALL
    SELECT payer FROM v WHERE payer IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT payer
FROM final
ORDER BY payer <> 'All', payer

queryLines:

datasets.name: kpi_visits
queryLines:
WITH picked AS (
    SELECT visit_month, MEASURE(visits) AS visits
    FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.operations
    WHERE (:payer = 'All' OR payer = :payer)
      AND (:hospital = 'All' OR hospital = :hospital)
      AND (:visit_type = 'All' OR visit_type = :visit_type)
    GROUP BY ALL
),
network AS (
    SELECT visit_month, MEASURE(visits) AS visits
    FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.operations
    GROUP BY ALL
),
sums AS (
    SELECT coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN p.visit_month BETWEEN w.window_start AND w.last_month THEN p.visits END), 0) AS last_12,
           coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN p.visit_month BETWEEN w.prior_start AND w.prior_end THEN p.visits END), 0) AS prior_12
    FROM picked p CROSS JOIN healthcare_dev.metrics.kpi_window w
),
net AS (
    SELECT sum(CASE WHEN n.visit_month BETWEEN w.window_start AND w.last_month THEN n.visits END) AS network_12
    FROM network n CROSS JOIN healthcare_dev.metrics.kpi_window w
),
final AS (
    SELECT * FROM sums CROSS JOIN net
)
SELECT healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(last_12, last_12) AS visits,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(prior_12, prior_12) AS visits_prior,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(last_12, healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(prior_12, round(100 * try_divide(last_12 - prior_12, prior_12), 1))) AS visits_change_pct,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(last_12, healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(network_12, round(100 * try_divide(last_12, network_12), 1))) AS visits_share_of_network_pct
FROM final

datasets.name: kpi_stays
queryLines:
WITH picked_last AS (
    SELECT MEASURE(stays) AS stays, MEASURE(avg_length_of_stay_days) AS los, MEASURE(cost_per_stay) AS cost
    FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.stays
    WHERE admit_month BETWEEN (SELECT window_start FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.kpi_window)
                          AND (SELECT last_month FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.kpi_window)
      AND (:payer = 'All' OR payer = :payer)
      AND (:hospital = 'All' OR hospital = :hospital)
),
picked_prior AS (
    SELECT MEASURE(stays) AS stays, MEASURE(avg_length_of_stay_days) AS los, MEASURE(cost_per_stay) AS cost
    FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.stays
    WHERE admit_month BETWEEN (SELECT prior_start FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.kpi_window)
                          AND (SELECT prior_end FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.kpi_window)
      AND (:payer = 'All' OR payer = :payer)
      AND (:hospital = 'All' OR hospital = :hospital)
),
network_last AS (
    SELECT MEASURE(stays) AS stays, MEASURE(avg_length_of_stay_days) AS los, MEASURE(cost_per_stay) AS cost
    FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.stays
    WHERE admit_month BETWEEN (SELECT window_start FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.kpi_window)
                          AND (SELECT last_month FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.kpi_window)
),
final AS (
    SELECT l.stays, l.los, l.cost,
           p.stays AS prior_stays, p.los AS prior_los, p.cost AS prior_cost,
           n.stays AS network_stays, n.los AS network_los, n.cost AS network_cost
    FROM picked_last l CROSS JOIN picked_prior p CROSS JOIN network_last n
)
SELECT healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays, stays) AS stays,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(prior_stays, prior_stays) AS stays_prior,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays, healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(prior_stays, round(100 * try_divide(stays - prior_stays, prior_stays), 1))) AS stays_change_pct,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays, round(los, 1)) AS avg_length_of_stay_days,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(prior_stays, round(prior_los, 1)) AS avg_length_of_stay_days_prior,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays, healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(prior_stays, round(los - prior_los, 1))) AS length_of_stay_change_days,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays, healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(network_stays, round(los - network_los, 1))) AS length_of_stay_vs_network_days,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays, round(cost, 0)) AS cost_per_stay,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(prior_stays, round(prior_cost, 0)) AS cost_per_stay_prior,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays, healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(prior_stays, round(100 * try_divide(cost - prior_cost, prior_cost), 1))) AS cost_change_pct,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays, healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(network_stays, round(100 * try_divide(cost - network_cost, network_cost), 1))) AS cost_vs_network_pct
FROM final

datasets.name: kpi_readmission
queryLines:
WITH r AS (
    SELECT admit_period, MEASURE(index_stays) AS index_stays, MEASURE(readmitted) AS readmitted,
           MEASURE(readmission_rate_pct) AS rate
    FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.readmission
    WHERE admit_period IN ('2010-2019', '2020-2026')
    GROUP BY ALL
),
final AS (
    SELECT max(CASE WHEN admit_period = '2020-2026' THEN index_stays END) AS stays_now,
           max(CASE WHEN admit_period = '2020-2026' THEN readmitted END) AS readmitted_now,
           max(CASE WHEN admit_period = '2020-2026' THEN rate END) AS rate_now,
           max(CASE WHEN admit_period = '2010-2019' THEN index_stays END) AS stays_before,
           max(CASE WHEN admit_period = '2010-2019' THEN readmitted END) AS readmitted_before,
           max(CASE WHEN admit_period = '2010-2019' THEN rate END) AS rate_before
    FROM r
)
SELECT healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(readmitted_now, healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays_now - readmitted_now, round(rate_now, 2))) AS readmission_rate_pct_2020_2026,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(readmitted_before, healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays_before - readmitted_before, round(rate_before, 2))) AS readmission_rate_pct_2010_2019
FROM final

datasets.name: care_gaps
queryLines:
WITH g AS (
    SELECT measure, measure_year, MEASURE(eligible) AS eligible, MEASURE(closed) AS closed,
           MEASURE(closure_rate_pct) AS rate
    FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.care_gaps
    GROUP BY ALL
),
final AS (
    SELECT CASE measure WHEN 'diabetes_hba1c' THEN 'Diabetes: HbA1c tested'
                        WHEN 'bp_control' THEN 'Hypertension: blood pressure controlled'
                        WHEN 'statin_therapy' THEN 'Heart disease: on a statin'
                        ELSE measure END AS measure,
           measure_year, eligible, closed, rate
    FROM g
)
SELECT measure,
       measure_year,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(eligible, eligible) AS eligible,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(closed, healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(eligible - closed, round(rate, 1))) AS closure_rate_pct
FROM final
ORDER BY measure

datasets.name: visits_trend
queryLines:
WITH v AS (
    SELECT visit_month, visit_type, MEASURE(visits) AS visits
    FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.operations
    WHERE visit_month >= DATE'2018-01-01'
      AND visit_month <= (SELECT last_month FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.kpi_window)
      AND (:payer = 'All' OR payer = :payer)
      AND (:hospital = 'All' OR hospital = :hospital)
      AND (:visit_type = 'All' OR visit_type = :visit_type)
    GROUP BY ALL
),
final AS (
    -- Six types by name; home, virtual, snf and hospice (under 2% of visits
    -- together) fold into other, so the chart keeps under eight series.
    SELECT visit_month,
           CASE WHEN visit_type IN ('ambulatory', 'wellness', 'outpatient', 'urgentcare', 'emergency', 'inpatient')
                THEN visit_type ELSE 'other' END AS visit_type,
           sum(visits) AS visits
    FROM v
    GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT visit_month,
       visit_type,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(visits, visits) AS visits
FROM final
ORDER BY visit_month, visit_type

datasets.name: stays_trend
queryLines:
WITH final AS (
    SELECT admit_quarter, MEASURE(stays) AS stays, MEASURE(avg_length_of_stay_days) AS los,
           MEASURE(cost_per_stay) AS cost
    FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.stays
    WHERE admit_quarter >= DATE'2018-01-01'
      AND add_months(admit_quarter, 2) <= (SELECT last_month FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.kpi_window)
      AND (:payer = 'All' OR payer = :payer)
      AND (:hospital = 'All' OR hospital = :hospital)
    GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT admit_quarter,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays, stays) AS stays,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays, round(los, 1)) AS avg_length_of_stay_days,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays, round(cost, 0)) AS cost_per_stay
FROM final
ORDER BY admit_quarter

datasets.name: by_payer
queryLines:
WITH p AS (
    SELECT payer, MEASURE(stays) AS stays, MEASURE(avg_length_of_stay_days) AS los,
           MEASURE(cost_per_stay) AS cost
    FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.stays
    WHERE admit_month BETWEEN (SELECT window_start FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.kpi_window)
                          AND (SELECT last_month FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.kpi_window)
      AND (:payer = 'All' OR payer = :payer)
      AND (:hospital = 'All' OR hospital = :hospital)
    GROUP BY ALL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           sum(CASE WHEN stays BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN stays ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS small_sum,
           count_if(stays BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OVER () AS small_groups,
           CASE WHEN stays > 10 THEN row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY stays > 10 ORDER BY stays, payer) END AS big_rank,
           sum(stays) OVER (PARTITION BY stays > 10 ORDER BY stays, payer ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS big_cum,
           lead(stays) OVER (PARTITION BY stays > 10 ORDER BY stays, payer) AS next_big
    FROM p
),
protected AS (
    -- Secondary suppression with a protection interval (D72, E61). The
    -- stays tile minus the shown rows gives the hidden total L. A reader who
    -- knows this rule knows each hidden large payer holds 11 or more stays
    -- and no more than the smallest shown one (next_big). Hiding the j
    -- smallest large payers leaves the small total at least L - j * next_big.
    -- Hide the fewest that push that bound to 1 or below, so the small
    -- payers could hold anything from 1 to 10.
    SELECT *,
           min(CASE WHEN stays > 10
                     AND (next_big IS NULL OR small_sum + big_cum - big_rank * next_big <= 1)
                    THEN big_rank END) OVER () AS hide_through
    FROM ranked
),
final AS (
    -- A NULL privacy_n makes shown() return NULL.
    SELECT *,
           CASE WHEN small_groups > 0 AND big_rank <= hide_through THEN NULL ELSE stays END AS privacy_n
    FROM protected
)
SELECT payer,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(privacy_n, stays) AS stays,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(privacy_n, round(los, 1)) AS avg_length_of_stay_days,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(privacy_n, round(cost, 0)) AS cost_per_stay
FROM final
ORDER BY stays DESC NULLS LAST

datasets.name: by_hospital
queryLines:
WITH h AS (
    SELECT hospital, MEASURE(stays) AS stays, MEASURE(avg_length_of_stay_days) AS los,
           MEASURE(cost_per_stay) AS cost
    FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.stays
    WHERE admit_month BETWEEN (SELECT window_start FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.kpi_window)
                          AND (SELECT last_month FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.kpi_window)
      AND (:payer = 'All' OR payer = :payer)
      AND (:hospital = 'All' OR hospital = :hospital)
    GROUP BY ALL
),
n AS (
    SELECT MEASURE(stays) AS network_stays, MEASURE(avg_length_of_stay_days) AS network_los,
           MEASURE(cost_per_stay) AS network_cost
    FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.stays
    WHERE admit_month BETWEEN (SELECT window_start FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.kpi_window)
                          AND (SELECT last_month FROM healthcare_dev.metrics.kpi_window)
),
final AS (
    SELECT * FROM h CROSS JOIN n
)
SELECT hospital,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays, stays) AS stays,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays, round(los, 1)) AS avg_length_of_stay_days,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays, healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(network_stays, round(los - network_los, 1))) AS length_of_stay_vs_network_days,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays, round(cost, 0)) AS cost_per_stay,
       healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(stays, healthcare_dev.metrics.shown(network_stays, round(100 * try_divide(cost - network_cost, network_cost), 1))) AS cost_vs_network_pct
FROM final
WHERE stays > 10
ORDER BY stays DESC

lines: Hospital stays, visits, length of stay, cost and quality for one hospital network. Synthetic data (Synthea). **null = hidden**: a group of 1-10 stays, visits, readmissions or patients, or the smallest group beside a single hidden one. The readmission and care-gap figures cover the whole network and ignore the filters.

## What the last 12 months show (Aug 2025 - Jul 2026, whole network; written from this data load)
1. **More stays, cheaper and shorter.** Hospital stays rose 6.0% (497 against 469) while cost per stay fell 7.2% ($24.2K against $26.0K) and the average stay shortened from 5.4 to 5.2 days. Visits were flat (54.0K against 54.5K).
2. **Medicare is half the inpatient book and the costliest.** It holds 243 of 497 stays at $32,034 per stay. Medicaid and Dual Eligible stays run longest (6.4 and 6.2 days, against 5.2 for the network).
3. **Blood pressure control is the widest care gap.** 67.0% of 2,135 eligible patients are controlled, against 82.9% for diabetes HbA1c testing and 97.7% for statins.

**What to do about it**
1. **Start a hypertension outreach programme.** It is the biggest gap on the largest group. Measure it by this closure rate in the next measure year.
2. **Review discharge planning for Medicaid and Dual Eligible stays.** Watch their length of stay in the payer table against the network's 5.2 days.
3. **Check case mix before crediting the cost fall.** Cost per stay swings by quarter (see the trend), and every hospital row but the largest rests on 11-16 stays. Read single hospitals over a longer window before acting on one.

*Synthetic data (Synthea): the 30-day readmission rate (1.39% for 2020-2026) is far below real-world levels, and some "hospitals" are outpatient clinics that hold inpatient encounters.*
